solutionSql:
SELECT c.id, c.name
FROM customers AS c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1
  FROM shipments AS s
  WHERE s.customer_id = c.id
    AND s.status = 'delivered'
)
ORDER BY c.id;

ambiguities.alternativeReading: A shipment_events row with status 'delivered'. Measured here: returns six customers (2, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8) instead of two.

notes: The status-based reading returns only customers 7 and 8. The ticket lists queued, in_transit and cancelled shipments, which supports reading status as shipments.status.
